title: A saved role with Settings OFF has no Settings area in the sidebar
custom_preconds: 1. A user is assigned a role with the Settings toggle OFF.
custom_steps: 1. Log in as that user and look at the left sidebar.
custom_expected: The Settings area is not shown at all — none of its pages (Settings, Staff, Roles & Permissions, Departments, Locations, Taxes, Billing Portal) are visible.
evidence: UI: the Technician role (no settings* perms) has no Settings area in the sidebar — a saved role with Settings OFF has no Settings section.
